    meta:
        description = "Detects rundll32.exe loading DLLs from user temp directories"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        maltype = "TROJAN"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1059.003"

        $s4 = "-sta" fullword ascii
        $s5 = "-system" fullword ascii
    condition:
        $s1 and ($s2 or $s3) and ($s4 or $s5)
}
